text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: "Wooooow...! Holy crap, this is insane!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"This hotel is so freakin' nice! 
Summeeerrrr! I'm so hyped! 
Totally feels like Summer Walk has 
officially started."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Alright City... yeeeah, one more! 
...Sweet. 
Also, they got lamps and stuff, so night 
shots are gonna pop. I wanna do dinner 
outside~"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Ah... I checked, but I think it was fully 
booked already."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Pien. I wanted to have an aesthetic 
dinner with you, City. But oh well~ 
Alright! Let's drop our bags off in the 
room and go shopping!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Yoooooo!! Jordan! 
City-wi, what's uuuuup☆"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, it's Palmer and Helios! 
Wait, you guys came out here too? 
Should've told us~"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Check our Umastagram, duh! Peace out 
first, yaaay♪ ...Oh, look look! 
We've been sightseeing since yesterday, 
and like... didn't this pic turn out crazy 
good?!"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Ah! That's the spot I was planning to 
visit! Nice~. 
Wait Helios, why do you look so deep and 
moody? Who even are you? Hilarious."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Palmer-chin told me, 'Wouldn't it pop so 
much harder like this?!' 
It's the power of Besties taking photos♪"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"There's a ton of photo spots around here. 
As her personal photographer, I had to 
bring my A-game! I've got plenty more 
pics!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Fr! We did the tourist thing, shopped, 
swam, took a boat ride, went bungee 
jumping, swam again, made a sandcastle, 
ate, and partied in our room till morning☆

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Brutal. Like, there's a lot to process 
here, but that schedule is brutal.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Palmer, are you doing okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I'm having a blast! Whenever I 
usually go to a resort, I just end up 
golfing the whole time. This feels totally 
fresh! Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
So, what are you two up to next? We're 
hitting the shops, wanna come? Actually, 
you gotta come♪ Gals, roll out! Go-go 
vroom-vroom♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
—Jordan! Did you pick out the ultimate 
summer item? 
All right... ready, set... GO! 
...Bwahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
We're matching! Summer's all about this, 
for real~♪ As expected of Jordan, your 
sense is so on point!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Nah, I was trying to make a joke. Nobody 
actually walks around carrying a water 
gun.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wait, but isn't that kinda a vibe?! What 
do you think, Model City-san? This year's 
hottest trend: water guns! Can we pull it 
off?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I could see it if it was a themed 
collection. Like "Japanese Seaside Summer" 
or something?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
OMG, City just gave it the stamp of 
approval! Is this a runway already?! The 
Daitaku Helios First Collection, "Summer," 
starts nooow!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! That's epic, go Helios! So freakin' 
cool~~! That's my bestie for ya! Woo-hoo♪

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: TWEEEEET! HEY, YOU TWO—!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Bamboo, you're here too?! 
No waaaay! Yaaay☆

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Don't "yaaaay" me! Keep your voices down! 
You're bothering the other guests!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Sowwyyyyy☆ Wait, why the track suit? Is 
this the Tracen Academy Resort Branch or 
something?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No, it's just easier to move around 
on patrol. Besides, who cares what I'm 
wearing? More importantly—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Bam-chan, no way! You wear your uniform at 
school, right? Track suit for training. 
So, pop quiz! What do you wear at a 
resort?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: A track suit! Because it's comfortable!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Helios, she's a repeat offender right 
here.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Fr! The time is roughly noon! Bamboo 
Memory, you're under arrest for having 
zero resort vibes! ...Sentence: Dress-up 
punishment, let's do it☆

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
......Huh? 
Wait—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: —Whaaaaat?!?! Wh-What is this all about—?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Told ya! It's the dress-up punishment~! 
We're gonna style you with a legit resort 
coord! Straw hat, bam♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Pfft, haha! Lookin' cute! But like, gotta 
make it more gal, right? Onto the next 
one, please!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
What?! W-Wait a second! Aren't you all 
just messing around with me?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... it feels too effortless. Let's aim 
for a bit more of that upperclassman vibe. 
And maybe subtract a few pieces—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Looking good, Bamboo, you're slaying! 
Let's try a fresh and chic look next! Keep 
'em coming, change it up!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaaaa...?! A-All right, fine, I'll 
change! Just... give me a secondーーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
—Okay, nails are dry. Summer Bamboo-san is 
compleeeete! Yay.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! Wow, it's so glossy... and so 
airy... Wait, without my headband, I 
feel... kind of weird!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You're in mandatory off-mode, so deal with 
it. But like... yeah, totally. Are we 
geniuses? Kept your vibe while screaming 
summer. Total geniuses. It looks great on 
you.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
R-Really...? Well, if City says so... 
...Whoa! I'm actually starting to feel the 
summer spirit!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Full-on summer vibes, right~?! At 
this point, we just gotta ride the "Super 
Screamer Summer Sky Coaster" together! 
Right, Bam-chan?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
No way! I have my patrol! To protect 
everyone's summer... I'm heading 
outーーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Girl, take a break.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Can't be helped! 
Guess it's just the usual crew for the 
coaster! Here we gooo☆

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Actually, count us out on that one. For 
real. City and I are gonna keep shopping 
for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Gotcha! I'll DM you later then! Send your 
location and we'll zoom right over! Let's 
hype up this summer walk to the max~~☆
